subject: AWS Marketplace usage reporting handshake & contract clauses
messages:
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Salim Patel <salim.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace usage reporting handshake & contract clauses

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the kickoff.

Quick context from our side: AcmeCloud is finalizing internal billing so we need the following to be tightly defined before we flip the Marketplace listing to billable:

- Canonical usage metric (we use active seats + API units; we need to confirm which "usage dimension" you will emit to AWS Metering API)
- Entitlement mapping (we need a deterministic mapping between Redwood customer IDs and AWS entitlement records so downstream invoices match)
- Reporting cadence and reconciliation window (we prefer daily usage pushes but need 7-day reconciliation window for chargebacks)

Can you share an example of the usage payload you will emit (fields + sample values) and any S3/reporting hooks? Also, our procurement team will want contract language for: settlement timing, dispute process, and data retention for meter logs.

If helpful, Salim can join a technical call. Can you propose times early next week?

—Jill
Customer Success | AcmeCloud
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace usage reporting handshake & contract clauses

Thanks Jill — great summary and happy to align. Below are answers and a few asks from our end. Attaching an initial usage mapping spreadsheet (2026-09-24_acme_usage_mapping_v1.xlsx).

1) Canonical usage metric: Redwood will emit a single AWS "UsageDimension" per plan. For your API-based plan we recommend: acme.api_units (integer) + metadata: account_id, region, timestamp, request_type. For seat-based plans we emit acme.active_seats.

2) Entitlement mapping: We need a stable field from AcmeCloud — either the AWS entitlement ID (if you can provide) or the Acme account external_id that we can map on our side. Our preferred flow: on customer onboarding we record the AWS entitlement ARN and persist it in Redwood's mapping table.

3) Reporting cadence & reconciliation: We'll push daily usage to AWS Metering (UTC 02:00) and provide a reconciliation export (S3 presigned CSV) each morning. We can support a 7-day reconciliation window; after that charges are considered settled.

4) APIs & payload: sample payload is in tab "PayloadExample" in the attached spreadsheet. High-level fields: account_external_id, entitlement_arn, usage_dimension, quantity, usage_start, usage_end, invoice_reference.

Proposed next steps:
- Tech sync w/ Salim and Karthik to confirm entitlement handshake + sample payload (30 min)
- Redwood sends draft contract clause language for settlement & dispute (we can do that by EOD Tue)

Availability: Mon Sep 27, 10:00–11:30 PT or Tue Sep 28, 13:00–15:00 PT. Let me know which works and I’ll set a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Principal, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: quick notes on mapping + edge cases for Acme

Looping in a few implementation edge cases ahead of the call with Salim:

- Multiple entitlements per account: Acme may provision per-product entitlements. Our mapping needs to support 1:N (Redwood account -> multiple entitlement ARNs). We'll include product_id in the mapping key.
- Backfilled usage: if they backfill older usage via CSV, we need firm SLA rules for when Redwood will accept backfill and when AWS will bill retroactively. Suggest: accept backfill up to 7 days with signed email from Acme procurement; anything older requires a manual reconciliation ticket.
- Metering idempotency: we'll include idempotency keys based on invoice_reference + usage window to avoid double-billing when retries occur.
- Sandbox vs production: ensure entitlements emitted to the AWS Metering API are blocked for sandbox customers (separate usage_dimension: acme.env=sandbox).

I drafted the first-pass contract language for the settlement/dispute flow — attaching a doc we can hand to legal + procurement (proposed_contract_clauses_Sept30.docx). Primary asks for legal: define "reconciliation window", specify timing for refunds or credits (30 days after reconciliation), and require a 30-day notice for pricing changes.

Will be on the call Tue 28 if scheduled.

—Ben
Billing Systems Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmecloud.com>, Salim Patel <salim.patel@acmecloud.com>, ProcureOps <procure@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace usage reporting handshake & contract clauses

Thanks all — good sync today. Summary + next steps: 

Summary decisions made:
- Usage dimension: acme.api_units (primary) and acme.active_seats (secondary for hybrid plans).
- Entitlement mapping approach: Acme will provide the entitlement ARN at onboarding; fallback is account_external_id matching with documented preflight checks.
- Reporting cadence: Redwood pushes daily at 02:00 UTC + reconciliation CSV S3 export; 7-day reconciliation window accepted.
- Backfills: Acme can request backfills up to 7 days with procurement approval; older requests handled via manual reconciliation.

Action items & owners:
- Acme (Salim): provide a sample entitlement ARN list for three pilot customers by Fri Oct 2.
- Redwood (Karthik): publish the sample Metering API payload and idempotency spec to the shared Drive (ETA Mon Oct 4). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d
- Redwood (Ben): confirm S3 export layout and retention policy; propose 90 days retention for meter CSVs (ETA Mon Oct 4).
- Procurement (Acme & ProcureOps): review proposed contract clauses in attached doc and provide redlines by Wed Oct 6. DocuSign link will be shared once redlines cleared.

I attached the two artifacts we referenced during the call: 2026-09-24_acme_usage_mapping_v1.xlsx and proposed_contract_clauses_Sept30.docx.

If there are any missing items from this recap, reply-all and I’ll update the thread. I’ll also open a HubSpot deal note (DL-2026-0543) with these tasks so both teams can track progress.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Principal, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650-555-0123
